steps.note: the API built this case's state

Close the live auction so its final bid can be awarded.
Open the comparison grid where the auction bids and final ranking are shown.
Award the entire event to the lowest-ranked final bid and submit the proposal.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the award approval flow and create the purchase order.
Open the History tab where completed events should appear.
